messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Autumn Evenings

A mild, overcast Friday invites local exploration, with a full moon promising a luminous night. The University of Michigan's new soundwave cancer treatment center offers a significant scientific thread.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 69°F and a low around 45°F, with a negligible chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset at 7:26 PM, under a nearly full moon at 97.6% illumination.
Arts and Music Around Town

Ann Arbor's Kerrytown Concert House hosts pianist Barron Ryan at 6:30 PM for a blend of classical and cool jazz. In Detroit, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum offers Dossin After-Dark with live jazz and cocktails starting at 6:00 PM.
Tomorrow marks the kickoff for The Big Read in Ypsilanti at 11:00 AM.
University of Michigan Advances Cancer Treatment Research

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to further develop non-invasive cancer treatments utilizing soundwaves. This technique, already FDA-approved for liver tumors, aims to break apart tumors without surgery or radiation.
A Weekend of Community and Culture
Saturday offers a free outdoor screening of "Best in Show" at Detroit's Campus Martius Park at 7:00 PM, and the Ypsilanti Library hosts Spinning Dot Theatre's "Mariposa/Butterfly" at 2:00 PM.
Satellites Navigate Autonomously, Roman Telescope Prepares for Launch

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. Meanwhile, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review and is preparing for final launch preparations.
The next Starship launch attempt is not officially scheduled, with independent estimates suggesting no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Find a quiet corner of the day and let it unfold.
